selection: All offer snapshots for a window must be complete. Minimum mover-perspective saved best-response score, same prior gap mate rank, UCI tie break. Assert exact selected acceptance and depth against GAP-FEATURES. No ratings/truth use.
material: Signed loss relative to balance BEFORE played move, mover perspective. Pawn90 knight/bishop300 rook500 queen1000. Acceptance is ply1; own replies are even plies. Physical balance retained for mates.
horizons: Use acceptance plus saved best PV only. At plies6/12 use exact physical debt, or extend the actual automatic terminal position unchanged. Null for truncated nonterminal PV.
recovery: For strictly positive initial_debt only: first own reply at plies2..12 with debt<=0. recovered_by12=1 if found,0 only when fully observed12 or automatic terminal without recovery; otherwise null. first_recovery_ply=null when no known recovery. initial_debt<=0 => both recovery features null with diagnostic reason.
mate_outcome: Saved best-line mate score multiplied by mover color sign gives +1 or -1, finite cp gives0. Independent of PV truncation and physical debt.
terminal_draw: python-chess outcome(claim_draw=False), replay full original PGN history. Automatic stalemate, insufficient material, fivefold repetition, 75moves are draws.1 for draw within12;0 for full12 nonterminal or actual terminal mate within12;otherwise null. Claimable threefold/50moves do not terminate.
missing: No qualifying offer, unknown offer mapping, or any incomplete acceptance snapshot window => all seven null. Missingness is explicit null, not0.
validation: Legal full saved PV; source FEN/PGN/history hashes; exact prior gap selection; current selected acceptance trace comparison to saved48 pilot PROBES; focused missingness and automatic terminal examples.
output_schema: TRAJECTORY-FEATURES: {case_key:{current:{feature_name:number|null},previous:{feature_name:number|null}}}. EXTRACTION diagnostics contain reasons, selected UCI/depth, full observed <=12 trace with FEN/history hash, terminal outcomes. No model scoring.
